content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in St. Louis

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience before you apply. Review PMI's specific requirements for your background—whether you hold a bachelor's degree, associate's degree, or high school diploma affects your required hours of hands-on project work. Verify your qualifications early to avoid delays.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Over 5 days of interactive online instruction, active certified practitioners guide you through the PMBOK® Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world application. Our cohort model keeps you accountable and connected to peers pursuing the same credential across the country.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing training, formally apply through PMI's online portal, upload your education and work verification, and pay the exam registration fee. Our team provides step-by-step guidance to ensure your application meets all requirements and processes without rejection or delay.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and Q&A sessions—to build confidence in the testing domains. Schedule your proctored exam at a time and location that fits your schedule. Pass the PMP exam to earn your credential and validate your expertise to employers across St. Louis's major industries.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: PMP certification is valid for three years. During each renewal cycle, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, volunteering, or continuing education to demonstrate your ongoing commitment to project-management excellence. Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible courses to support your renewal journey.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
